title: Battle of Ushant (1782)
text: The Battle of Ushant was fought on 20–21 April 1782 during the American Revolutionary War between a French Navy squadron of three ships of the line protecting a convoy of 12 transport ships and a Royal Navy fleet off Ushant, a French island at the mouth of the English Channel off the northwesternmost point of France. It was the third battle that occurred in this region during the war, and resulted in a clear British victory.
